items.title: Kalshi perpetual futures volume runs many times open interest, drawing expert scrutiny
items.content_text: - **Kalshi perpetual futures volume runs many times open interest, drawing expert scrutiny** — Trading volume on Kalshi bitcoin and ether perpetual futures runs about 42 and 66 times open interest, far above comparable ratios on Polymarket and Hyperliquid, and finance professors quoted in the report question whether incentive programs are inflating the churn.
